SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK
COUNTY OF NEW YORK
---------------------------------------------------------------x
13 HARRISON LLC, ARNULF DAMERAU, and
THE BOARD OF MANAGERS OF THE 13 HARRISON STREET CONDOMINIUM,
                                         Plaintiffs,
                         -against-                                Index No. ___________
MICHAEL BLEICH and ALEXIS BLEICH,
                                         Defendants.
---------------------------------------------------------------x

NOTICE OF MOTION TO CONSOLIDATE RELATED ACTIONS (CPLR 602)

PLEASE TAKE NOTICE that upon the annexed Affirmation of [Counsel], dated [date], the
accompanying Memorandum of Law, and the exhibits annexed thereto, Plaintiffs will move this
Court, at IAS Part [33] of the Supreme Court, New York County, located at 60 Centre Street,
New York, New York, on [return date], or as soon thereafter as counsel may be heard, for an
Order pursuant to CPLR 602:

1. Consolidating this action with Michael Bleich and Alexis Bleich v. Board of Managers of
   13 Harrison Street Condominium, et al., Index No. 155721/2024 (Rosado, J.), for all purposes;
   and directing that all further proceedings be conducted under Index No. 155721/2024; or

2. In the alternative, directing joint discovery and a joint trial of the two actions before Justice
   Mary V. Rosado, and assigning this action as related to Index No. 155721/2024; and

3. Granting such other and further relief as the Court deems just and proper.

Dated: New York, New York
       [__________], 2025

                                            [FIRM]
                                            Attorneys for Plaintiffs
                                            [Address]
                                            By: ______________________

SUPREME COURT OF THE STATE OF NEW YORK COUNTY OF NEW YORK
-	x
OPEHLLC,

Plaintiff,	Index No.

-against-	SUMMONS

MICHAEL E. BLEICH and ALEXIS K. BLEICH,

Defendants.
-	x

TO THE ABOVE NAMED DEFENDANTS:

You are hereby summoned and required to submit to Plaintiffs attorney your answering papers on this motion within the time provided in the notice of motion annexed hereto. In case of your failure to submit answering papers, summary judgment will be taken against you by default for the relief demanded in the notice of motion.
The basis of venue is Plaintiffs choice pursuant to CPLR §503.

PLEASE TAKE FURTHER NOTICE that answering papers, if any, must be served on the undersigned so that they are received no later than seven (7) days before the return date.
Dated: New York, New York September 27, 2018
